entries.original: Added GitLab merge request URL support to the `--worktree` flag and the `claude agents` view (where MRs display as `!N`)
entries.translated: `--worktree` 플래그와 `claude agents` 뷰(MR이 `!N`으로 표시됨)에 GitLab 머지 리퀘스트 URL 지원 추가

entries.original: Added an opt-in `forward_user_identity` apps gateway setting on Anthropic upstreams that sends the signed-in user's identity as headers, so a proxy behind the gateway can attribute spend per user
entries.translated: Anthropic 업스트림에 선택 사항인 `forward_user_identity` 앱 게이트웨이 설정을 추가하여, 로그인한 사용자의 식별 정보를 헤더로 전송하고 게이트웨이 뒤의 프록시가 사용자별 비용을 할당할 수 있도록 개선

entries.original: Added opt-in memory cgroup support for Bash tool commands on Linux (`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`) so a runaway build can't stall the session
entries.translated: Linux의 Bash 도구 명령에 선택 사항인 메모리 cgroup 지원(`CLAUDE_CODE_TOOL_MEMORY_LIMIT`)을 추가하여, 제어 불능 상태의 빌드가 세션을 중단시키지 않도록 방지

entries.original: Added `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` environment variable to configure the WebFetch session URL cache TTL (default unchanged: 15 minutes)
entries.translated: WebFetch 세션 URL 캐시의 TTL을 설정할 수 있는 `CLAUDE_CODE_WEBFETCH_CACHE_TTL_MS` 환경 변수 추가 (기본값 15분 유지)

entries.original: Fixed cloud sessions occasionally being marked as lost when the environment shut down while Claude was waiting on a permission prompt
entries.translated: Claude가 권한 승인 프롬프트를 대기하는 동안 환경이 종료될 때 클라우드 세션이 간혹 유실된 것으로 표시되던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed MCP v2 connections endlessly reopening the subscriptions/listen stream against servers that terminate long-held streams on a fixed timeout (e.g. serverless hosts)
entries.translated: 고정된 타임아웃으로 장기 연결 스트림을 종료하는 서버(예: 서버리스 호스트)에 대해 MCP v2 연결이 구독/리스닝 스트림을 끊임없이 다시 여는 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed Notification hooks not firing for permission prompts when running under Claude Desktop or VS Code
entries.translated: Claude Desktop 또는 VS Code에서 실행 시 권한 승인 프롬프트에 대한 알림 훅이 실행되지 않던 문제 수정

entries.original: Fixed idle sessions on Linux sometimes keeping one CPU core at 100% when sandboxing is enabled
entries.translated: Fixed idle sessions on Linux sometimes keeping one CPU core at 100% when sandboxing is enabled

entries.original: Fixed bundled skill aliases like `/checkup` and `/review` reporting "Unknown command" in `-p` mode or with plugins/MCP loaded when a user or project skill shadows the bundled skill
entries.translated: Fixed bundled skill aliases like `/checkup` and `/review` reporting "Unknown command" in `-p` mode or with plugins/MCP loaded when a user or project skill shadows the bundled skill

entries.original: Fixed skill/command argument substitution to prevent argument values from being re-expanded as template markers
entries.translated: Fixed skill/command argument substitution to prevent argument values from being re-expanded as template markers

entries.original: Fixed Windows paths spelled with the NT `\??\` device prefix bypassing UNC path validation, closing an NTLM credential-leak vector
entries.translated: Fixed Windows paths spelled with the NT `\??\` device prefix bypassing UNC path validation, closing an NTLM credential-leak vector

entries.original: Improved `claude self-hosted-runner` session start time: the session branch is now created without rewriting the working tree, and two server round trips no longer block the agent's launch
entries.translated: Improved `claude self-hosted-runner` session start time: the session branch is now created without rewriting the working tree, and two server round trips no longer block the agent's launch

entries.original: Improved apps gateway error forwarding: 400/413 errors from Vertex, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS upstreams now carry the upstream's own message; fixes a bug with auto-compact on apps gateway
entries.translated: Improved apps gateway error forwarding: 400/413 errors from Vertex, Foundry, and Claude Platform on AWS upstreams now carry the upstream's own message; fixes a bug with auto-compact on apps gateway

entries.original: Improved `claude plugin validate` to check a bare `.claude/skills` directory, reporting SKILL.md files whose frontmatter fails to parse
entries.translated: Improved `claude plugin validate` to check a bare `.claude/skills` directory, reporting SKILL.md files whose frontmatter fails to parse

entries.original: Improved screen reader mode: the `/effort` selector renders as a numbered list with a typed-number prompt, and hint and dialog text is no longer clipped
entries.translated: Improved screen reader mode: the `/effort` selector renders as a numbered list with a typed-number prompt, and hint and dialog text is no longer clipped

entries.original: Improved print mode diagnostics: a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` line is written to stderr when a request goes out for a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize; map it with `modelOverrides` to silence
entries.translated: Improved print mode diagnostics: a `[claude-code:unrecognized_model]` line is written to stderr when a request goes out for a model ID Claude Code doesn't recognize; map it with `modelOverrides` to silence

entries.original: Changed the GitHub app setup tip to no longer appear in repositories whose origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org; the enterprise marketplace tip now covers non-GitHub internal git hosts
entries.translated: Changed the GitHub app setup tip to no longer appear in repositories whose origin remote is on gitlab.com or bitbucket.org; the enterprise marketplace tip now covers non-GitHub internal git hosts

entries.original: Todo/task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) are no longer available on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to bring them back
entries.translated: Todo/task-tracking tools (TaskCreate/Get/Update/List, TodoWrite) are no longer available on Opus 4.8, Sonnet 5, Fable 5, Mythos 5, and newer models; set `CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TODO_TOOLS=1` to bring them back

entries.original: Windows: fixed auto mode repeatedly stopping for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands (a 2.1.232 regression)
entries.translated: Windows: fixed auto mode repeatedly stopping for manual approval on ordinary `cd <dir> && <command> > file` Bash commands (a 2.1.232 regression)

entries.original: Reverted the 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows and for input redirections (`< file`); a narrower version will return in a later release
entries.translated: Reverted the 2.1.232 Bash permission changes for Cygwin-style symlinks on Windows and for input redirections (`< file`); a narrower version will return in a later release
